content:
sam_sales: Heads-up 7 Acme wants a clear capacity plan for their enterprise commit. They expect 6k steady chat RPS, 24k peak for campaigns, p99 <= 180ms. Questions about reserved GPUs vs on-demand burst and how autoscale cooldowns play into SLA.
priya_se: Congrats! Quick checklist: model, avg tokens, context length, KV cache hit rate. Any of that from the POC?
mike_infra: POC used redwood/gpt-neo-extended-13b-q4 with avg request = 150 tokens, resp 100 tokens -> 250 tokens total. Context 1024.
lee_sre: Back-of-envelope: 6k * 250 = 1.5M tokens/sec. Our a100-like slot does ~150k tokens/s warm. So steady = 10 slots (1.5M/150k = 10). Peak 24k -> 4x -> 40 slots needed.
anya_prod: Note: benchmarks assume warmed KV cache and sustained throughput. Cold starts or cache misses can double latency. Recommend reserved = steady + 25% buffer -> 13 slots. Keep burst pool for remaining 27 slots.
sam_sales: Acme asked: if we reserve 13, how many burst GPU-hours would 27 extra for 3 hours/day be monthly? Need a sample invoice calc.
billing-bot: Pricing model: reserved SKU = discounted rate $9/hr (committed), burst rate = $15/hr. Example calc: 13 reserved * 24 * 30 * $9 = $84,840/mo. Burst usage: 27 * 3 * 30 * $15 = $36,450/mo. Total est = $121,290/mo. (placeholder numbers; final quote from finance).
priya_se: Ops note: autoscale cooldown default = 180s; scheduling + image pull ~60-90s. For abrupt 4x spikes you'll see request queuing. Two mitigations: prewarmed standby nodes or a scheduled preheat for campaign windows.
lee_sre: For strict p99 SLAs during campaigns we recommend preheat + keep min_instances = reserved_count. Autoscale should be used to reduce cost outside campaign windows.
mike_infra: Add fallback: automatic model downgrade to smaller quantized variant when overall cluster utilization > 85% to preserve latency SLOs. We can configure fallback policy in infra repo.
sam_sales: Also need security confirmation for "dedicated isolation" clause and audit logs of scale events for their compliance team.
audit-bot: Audit logs cover: scale events, admin actions, reservation changes. Can export to customer's S3 or Splunk. We can provide a signed attestation for the commit.
anya_prod: Draft handoff plan: 1) Reserve 13 slots. 2) Provision burst pool up to 40. 3) Define preheat schedules for campaign dates. 4) Set autoscale min=13, cooldown=180s, scale step small (2-4 nodes) to avoid overshoot. 5) Configure model-fallback rule at 85% util.
sam_sales: Can someone assemble a one-page summary (capacity vs cost + ops tradeoffs) I can send to Acme procurement? Need by COB today. @priya_se @anya_prod
priya_se: On it 44d. Will add a short appendix with KV cache warmup snippet for their infra team.
lee_sre: I'll add SLO testing notes and recommended load-test commands.
sam_sales: Thanks team. Filing ticket for reservation request.
billing-bot: Reservation request created -> TICKET-7821.
audit-bot: Compliance export sample uploaded: https://redwood.internal/compliance/acme/exports
sam_sales: Closing internal thread. Will share the PDF with customer after priya posts it.
